1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said diodes are mounted flush against the columnar body surface without protruding therefrom__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said open end is not closed by any optical element or diffuser__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is integrally formed with said columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and said phosphor material is applied as a coating directly to said diodes__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and each diode is positioned at a vertex of said columnar body__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and each fin is positioned at a midpoint between adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length-to-width ratio greater than 2:1__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned at the center of each face__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin extends radially outward by a distance greater than the diameter of said diodes__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode on each face is the only light-emitting element on that face__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected from the group consisting of copper alloys and aluminum alloys__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __wherein__ a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __and said optic element is separately formed from said columnar body__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and said base member includes a threaded connection for direct insertion into a standard light fixture__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and said circuitry includes a voltage regulator for maintaining constant output voltage to said diodes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and said optic element has a refractive index greater than 1.5__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein each diode is mounted flush against the side surface without protruding therefrom__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __by adhesive bonding or mechanical fastening__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __wherein the circuitry is pre-assembled on a separate module before insertion into said body__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from aluminum alloys with copper content__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed during the extrusion process as part of the body cross-section__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and said side walls are perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the body__.
